segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Okay, Q4 budget review shuru karte hain. Ashok, October ke actuals aa gaye?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Haan ma'am, October mein hum budget se kareeb aath percent upar gaye hain.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Aath percent? Kahan se aaya itna?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Sabse bada hissa marketing ka hai, festive campaign mein spend expected se zyada hua.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Aur travel bhi, sales team ne October mein bahut client visits kiye.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Revenue bhi aaya ya sirf kharcha hua?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Revenue thoda upar hai, par margin pe asar pada hai, collections slow hain.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Theek hai. Marketing ka Q4 budget kitna bacha hai?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Original plan ka lagbhag chalis percent bacha hai, par December mein year-end sale bhi hai.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Marketing wale bolenge sale ke liye paisa chahiye, cut karoge toh shor machega.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Shor machne do. Marketing ka Q4 budget dus percent cut karenge, sale ke andar hi adjust karein.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Dus percent cut matlab lagbhag chaar lakh bachenge.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Haan, final hai, main unke head ko khud bata dungi.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Laptop wali request ka kya? IT ne pandrah naye laptops maange hain.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Pandrah laptops matlab nau-das lakh, is quarter mein toh possible nahi.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Naye laptop purchase March tak freeze rahenge. Jo zaroori hai woh repair karwao.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Theek hai, main IT ko bata deti hoon ki freeze hai.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Ek suggestion tha, January mein poori team ka offsite Goa mein karein, morale ke liye.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Ashok, abhi hum cut ki baat kar rahe hain aur tum offsite bol rahe ho?

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Haha, timing thodi galat hai. Offsite ka kharcha bhi kam se kam das lakh hoga.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Offsite abhi nahi hoga, woh topic band karo, next year dekhenge.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Theek hai ma'am, samajh gaya.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Cash flow ka sabse bada sawaal hai. Collections slow hain toh January tak paisa kaise chalega?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Mujhe ek revised cash flow banana padega, har hafte ka, collections ke naye estimate ke saath.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Ashok, revised cash flow do hafte mein chahiye, board ke samne rakhna hai.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Haan, do hafte mein ready kar dunga. Waise statutory audit 30 November se shuru ho raha hai.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Audit apni jagah, cash flow uske upar priority hai.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Travel ka data main nikaal sakti hoon, kis team ne kitna spend kiya, client wise.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Haan Megha, travel spend ki report kal tak share kar do, team wise breakup ke saath.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Kal tak bhej dungi, expense tool se seedha export ho jata hai.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Vendor payments mein bhi gadbad hai, kuch invoices do baar book ho gaye hain lagta hai.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Kitne?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Pakka nahi pata, das-baarah ho sakte hain. Ledger aur bank statement milane padenge.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Woh reconciliation lamba kaam hai, ek bande se nahi hoga.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Toh vendor payments ka reconciliation hum log milke kar lenge, jiske paas time ho woh baithe.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Theek hai, shared sheet bana deta hoon taaki sab apne hisse ke invoices dekh sakein.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: GST input credit pe bhi asar padega agar duplicate invoices hain.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Haan, isliye reconciliation jaldi hona chahiye.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Subscriptions ka bhi dekho, bahut saare software tools hain jo koi use nahi karta.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Main list bana sakti hoon, par woh agle mahine, abhi travel report pehle.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Theek hai, subscriptions baad mein. Aur kuch?

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Salary revision ka sawaal aayega January mein, uska provision rakhna padega.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Woh December review mein lenge, abhi uske numbers bhi nahi hain.

segments.speaker: Megha Jain
segments.text: Mere side se bas itna hi.

segments.speaker: Ashok Pillai
segments.text: Mera bhi ho gaya.

segments.speaker: Sunita Reddy
segments.text: Theek hai, thank you dono ko. Cut wali baat abhi bahar mat bolna, main pehle heads se baat karungi.

decisions.fact: The marketing budget for Q4 is cut by 10 percent.
New laptop purchases are frozen until March.

action_items.fact: Ashok prepares a revised weekly cash flow for the board.
Megha shares the travel spend report with a team-wise breakup.
The vendor payments are reconciled jointly; nobody named.

distractors.fact: A team offsite in Goa in January was suggested and dropped.
30 November is the start of the statutory audit, not the cash flow's due date.
